answer: Strongest mechanism: vested epoch payouts. Each agent escrows a stake and rewards stream out linearly over many epochs, like a river depositing value gradually. Honest agents keep withdrawing vested share as they mature toward their zenith; sybils running flash-farm identities forfeit nearly everything, since unvested balances are lost on exit and escrow is collateral. An attacker must fund and park capital per fake identity for months, so cost scales like N honest deposits while returns stay capped, letting the reef shed sybils cheaply.
